title: ts-graph edge annotations
description: Annotation files are arrays. Inline --edge-label also accepts a single item. Paths are repository-relative; normalization, traversal rejection, duplicate edges and displayed-edge existence are checked by the CLI.

from.description: Importing file, relative to repository root.

to.description: Imported file, relative to repository root.

label.description: Plain text. Newlines are supported; HTML and Mermaid are escaped.
